name: Vehicle Job History
query:
select
	v.vehicle_name as "Vehicle::130",
	v.make_model as "Make / Model::160",
	v.customer_name as "Vehicle Owner::170",
	cwo.name as "Job:Link/Coach Work Order:140",
	cwo.stage as "Stage:Link/Work Stage:130",
	cwo.posting_date as "Job Date:Date:100",
	cwo.work_description as "Work::260",
	cwo.total_amount as "Amount:Currency:120"
from `tabCoach Work Vehicle` v
left join `tabCoach Work Order` cwo on cwo.vehicle = v.name
order by v.vehicle_name asc, cwo.posting_date desc
